mapper.select: SELECT tp.user_id AS teacherId, u.real_name AS realName, u.avatar AS avatar, tp.school_id AS schoolId, sc.name AS schoolName, tp.grade, tp.skilled_subjects AS skilledSubjects, tp.free_time AS freeTime, tp.skilled_subjects AS skilledSubjectsRaw, tp.free_time AS freeTimeRaw FROM teacher_profile tp LEFT JOIN school sc ON tp.school_id = sc.id LEFT JOIN user u ON tp.user_id = u.id WHERE tp.certification_status = 1 AND tp.continuous_match = 1 AND tp.deleted = 0 ORDER BY tp.total_service_duration ASC LIMIT 20
